correctness.rationale: Direct coordinate expansion gives h=e, fs=gs=0 and F=e²+fg+bg+cf=0. The reduced locus equals A union B; Gauss lemma with gcd(f,e²+g(b+f))=1 proves B irreducible dim5; the Jacobian of its hypersurface gives the scalar singular line. Cayley--Hamilton, centralizer action and rational canonical forms give every orbit and its size for all q=2^f. Standalone exhaustive checks over F2 and F4 independently replayed and agreed. No scheme radicality or general matrix dimension claim is made.

originality.rationale: The assessed claim is the reduced characteristic-two component geometry (including singular intersection) and all-field rational conjugacy-orbit classification, not the known labeled point count or irreducible-module description. Full-text comparisons show Iyudu assumes characteristic zero, and Benkart--Lopes--Ondrus treat irreducibles rather than this full orbit and geometric problem. Accessible own prior recorded the point count and admissible Y types, but not component closures or all module orbits. Targeted mathematical record searches produced no dominating statement. The Shirikov 2007 positive-characteristic full text remains unavailable, so novelty is provisional with explicitly recorded priority risk.

value.rationale: The smallest nontrivial matrix-size boundary n=2 in characteristic two shows a genuine failure of the all-dimensional characteristic-zero equidimensionality paradigm: components have different dimensions and a computable singular line. The exact 3q² rational module-isoclass census describes both reducible and simple strata and adds orbit information absent from labeled point counts. This is a motivated structural and moduli invariant, not a mere recomputation of previous pair totals.
